messages:
maya: 8-minute prelaunch safety check for EU midnight window — rolling v4.2.0 -> v4.3.0. Everyone on standby? :eyes:
simon: on my way, will keep an eye on canaries. ready to escalate if anything looks off.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: canary start initiated
```
deploy-bot: canary id=cb-8492  node=eu-west-1 pool=gpu-p4 model=redwood-v4.3.0 state=warming
```
aisha: smoke tests queued, running `/smoke e2e` -> 3/3 passed (login, inference, auth)
maya: pinned fallback rule: if error_rate > 2% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 400ms for 2m -> automatic pin to v4.2.0 and notify #incidents
tom: added pin in deploybot: `pin set model=redwood-v4.2.0 reason=rollback-safety window=eu-midnight`
simon: monitoring latency & token errors. alert thresholds in my dashboard set to 1.5x baseline — will call if we breach.
deploy-bot: :bar_chart: metrics update (rolling 3m): rps=200, p95=220ms (+5%), error_rate=0.4%
maya: good. reminder: no schema changes in this push, only attention/kv cache perf tweeks. if anything looks like token corruption escalate immediately.
aisha: release notes uploaded: https://github.com/redwood/release/v4.3.0 — highlights + perf regression notes + rollback steps.
tom: quick checklist done: smoke ok, canary healthy, feature flags staged, infra pins applied. backups snapshot at T-10m stored.
maya: GO in 2 minutes unless objections. maintain comms in this thread and #eng-oncall for ops chatter.
simon: no objections, proceeding. I'll be on-call for the first 30 min post-promote.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary passed gating checks; promoting traffic 30% -> 100% over 10m with circuit breaker enabled (err>2% or p95>400ms)
maya: logging change-window in ops doc, post-launch 30m watch. oncall: @simon please own pager for that window.
simon: acknowledged, staying on pager. will post updates here every 5m for first 20m.
maya: thanks team :rocket:
